desc: Implement prefix sum arrays for `nums` and `cost` to enable O(1) subarray sum queries.
Initialize a 2D DP array `dp[n+1][n+1]` with infinity, setting `dp[0][0] = 0`.
Write nested loops: outer loop `j` from 1 to `n` (number of subarrays), middle loop `i` from `j` to `n` (end of prefix), inner loop `k` from `j-1` to `i-1` (start index of the last subarray).
In the inner loop, calculate the cost of the subarray `nums[k..i-1]` as the `j`-th subarray using prefix sums and the formula `(sum_nums + k*j) * sum_cost`.
Update `dp[i][j]` with the minimum of its current value and `dp[k][j-1] + subarray_cost`.
